articles.summary: MarketAxess Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: MKTX) the operator of a leading electronic trading platform for fixed-income securities, will issue a press release announcing its second quarter 2026 financial results on Friday, August 7, 2026, before the market opens. Chris Concannon, Chief Executive Officer, and Ilene Fiszel Bieler, Chief Financial Officer, will host a conference call to provide a strategic update and discuss the Companys financial results and outlook on Friday, August 7, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. ET. To access the conference call, please dial +1-833-461-5787 (U.S.) or +1-585-542-9983 (International) and use the ID 856436548. The Company will also host a live audio Webcast of the conference call on the Investor Relations section of the Company's website at http://investor.marketaxess.com .
